description: Dynamic Island-style Windows desktop companion with media controls, system status, calendar, tasks, and quick controls.
notes: Scoop extracts the Inno Setup payload into the Scoop version directory; the upstream installer is not executed.
The upstream installer language-selection and first-install configuration script are skipped during extraction. The application defaults to Turkish until changed in its settings.
Settings and task data are stored under %APPDATA%\WinIsland, outside the Scoop app directory.
